mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission gate lets a Success outcome occur on a (role, op) cell that is not in the matrix. Injecting a CustomerRole caller succeeding at OpGetAudit (denied by the matrix) is a direct counterexample to least-privilege, customer-action-scope, and the no-audit-for-customers rule.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation, u: User | u.role = CustomerRole and op.caller = u and op.kind = OpGetAudit and op.outcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the existence half of audit-trail completeness lets the model invent an application that has reached UnderReview with zero audit entries — violating completeness, the submission-audit guarantee, and retention.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissingViolation { some a: LoanApplication | a.status = UnderReviewSt and (no e: AuditEntry | e.application = a) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing duplicate-prevention lets the model fabricate two distinct audit entries recording the same applied transition for one application — the canonical append-only / no-rewrites violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditDuplicateViolation { some disj e1, e2: AuditEntry | e1.application = e2.application and e1.newStatus = e2.newStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the no-leak/no-foreign-read constraint lets a customer successfully GET an application owned by another customer, violating both ownership-based access and the no-existence-leak rule.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakViolation { some op: Operation, a: LoanApplication, u: User | u.role = CustomerRole and op.caller = u and op.kind = OpGetApp and op.target = a and a.customer != u and op.outcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the assigned-officer gate on Decide lets a non-assigned loan officer successfully decide somebody else's claimed application — precisely SC-005's never-event.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonAssignedDecideViolation { some op: Operation, a: LoanApplication, disj u1, u2: User | u1.role = LoanOfficerRole and u2.role = LoanOfficerRole and op.caller = u1 and op.kind = OpDecide and op.target = a and a.assignedOfficer = u2 and op.outcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the in-flight uniqueness fact lets the same customer have two simultaneous Submitted/UnderReview applications, breaking FR-008's partial unique index invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoInFlightViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.customer = a2.customer and a1.status = SubmittedSt and a2.status = UnderReviewSt }
